title: A Kentucky man becomes the first humanist granted religious exemption from AI
description: (RNS) — David Durman, an administrator at the University of Kentucky, said using AI would cause him to offload his thinking and decision making, which would violate his humanist views. He hopes other Americans will rethink their views on AI, too.
